scope: Existing three unchanged synthetic inputs and analytic unit controls; no proteins or new catalog geometry. Native carrier selection is frozen before independent integration; it is not independent truth for global free-space connectivity.

observables.carrier: Finite disjoint-interior tetrahedral support, no atomic subtraction
observables.bare_empty: Carrier minus union of original atomic balls
observables.probe_center: Same declared carrier minus union of balls expanded by the declared query probe
observables.exterior_accessible: Unavailable: no integral over globally reachable subset claimed

units: Explicit nm in numeric core; public primary quantities use PyUnitWizard; figures/tables may convert to angstrom and angstrom**3.

mc_contract.interval: Two-sided Clopper-Pearson binomial confidence interval, confidence_level=0.95
mc_contract.legacy_error: Maximum distance from point estimate to either asymmetric interval endpoint. Nonzero for sampled all-hit/no-hit outcomes; exact zero allowed only for separately proven empty/covered/no-reaching-ball domains.
mc_contract.assumptions: IID uniform mixture on disjoint-interior carrier cells; uncertainty conditional on frozen support and ball model, excluding physical/model/support bias.

coverage.analytic_control: Interior radius0.1 ball centered at(.2,.2,.2) inside unit right tetrahedron
coverage.acceptance: At least90% of the128 retained independent-seed nominal95% intervals cover the analytic value; report actual fraction, a bounded diagnostic rather than universal proof.
coverage.exact_binomial_guard: Enumerate all counts at n=8,32 for probabilities .001,.01,.1,.5,.9,.99,.999; true binomial coverage must be >=.95 up to1e-12.

quadrature_contract.legacy_exact: Preserve fixed-order numeric values and tuple(volume,None); explicitly unknown quadrature error, no zero-error claim.
quadrature_contract.new_route: Bounded successive Gauss-order doubling, requiring two consecutive order differences <= atol + rtol*carrier_volume. Differences are convergence diagnostics, not certified deterministic error bounds.
quadrature_contract.work_proxy_definition: Sum over evaluated orders of K*order**2*max(1,n_obstacle_balls); a declared budget proxy, not an exact floating-operation or wall-time bound.
quadrature_contract.failure: Unresolved with history and unknown error if order/work budget is exhausted; preserve last estimate when evaluated.
quadrature_contract.analytic_acceptance: On the interior sphere unit control and verified nonoverlapping vertex sectors of frozen tetrahedron, actual error <=1e-4 carrier volume; record observed error separately from estimated convergence.

independent_reference.domain_freeze: Freeze actual resident/transit cells and atom/source correspondence before reference evaluation. Keep common parent hull for shell cap-deletion comparison.
independent_reference.method: Independent IID Cartesian bounding-box sampling with direct simplex halfspace membership and all-atom exclusion; Hoeffding two-sided finite-sample bounds, distinct from production simplex sampler and CP interval.
independent_reference.acceptance: Reference half-width <=2.5% of declared carrier volume and production95% interval overlaps reference99.9% interval; analytic tetrahedron target remains stronger.
independent_reference.tetrahedron: Independently check all six equal edges, radius-sector nonoverlap and opposite-face truncation before subtracting four solid-angle sectors. Expanded radii overlap and require the independent union exclusion reference.
independent_reference.shell_pair: Common parent hull and identical sample points for original/deleted-cap atom unions, both bare and1.4Å-expanded. Report nonnegative freed volume with uncertainty, not exterior-accessible volume.

receiving: Actual public DFND volume measurement with explicit availability, support IDs, source mappings, conditional uncertainty and attribution. Existing tuple API remains a compatibility route.
qualification: Source-only bounded numerical contract; no installed matrix, exact global cavity volume or biological accuracy claim.
